exercises.name: Push-up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower until your chest is a fist above the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
cues: Squeeze glutes so hips stay level

exercises.name: Knee push-up
instructions: Knees on the floor, body straight from knees to head.
Lower the chest towards the floor.
Press back up.
cues: Keep hips in line with the body

exercises.name: Incline push-up
instructions: Hands on a sturdy table, bench or step.
Walk feet back until the body is straight.
Lower the chest to the edge and press away.
mistakes: Using a surface that can slide

exercises.name: Decline push-up
instructions: Feet on a step or bed, hands on the floor.
Lower the chest under control.
Press back up.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
instructions: Hips high in an inverted V.
Bend the elbows to bring the head towards the floor between the hands.
Press back up.
mistakes: Turning it into a regular push-up

exercises.name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Hands together under the chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Lower with elbows close to the ribs.
Press up.

exercises.name: Chair dip
instructions: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair behind you, legs out.
Bend the elbows to about 90°.
Press back up.
mistakes: Going too deep with sore shoulders

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on the bench, dumbbells over the chest.
Lower to chest level, elbows about 45°.
Press back up until arms are straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor, knees bent, dumbbells over the chest.
Lower until the upper arms touch the floor.
Press up.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Bench at 30–45°.
Lower dumbbells to upper chest.
Press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on the bench, arms up with a soft bend.
Open the arms wide in an arc.
Squeeze back together.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press to straight arms.
cues: Use a spotter or safety pins

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press
instructions: Dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead to straight arms.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
instructions: Dumbbells at your sides.
Raise out to shoulder height, slight bend in elbows.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band chest press
instructions: Band behind your back at chest height.
Press forward to straight arms.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than shoulders, palms away.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower to straight arms.
cues: Start each rep by pulling the shoulders down

exercises.name: Weighted pull-up
instructions: Hold a dumbbell between the feet or use a belt.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower fully.
cues: Only once 10+ clean pull-ups are easy

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and put a knee or foot in it.
Pull up until the chin clears the bar.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
instructions: Jump or step to the top position.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: Chin-up
instructions: Palms facing you, shoulder width.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower fully.

exercises.name: Dead hang
instructions: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Shoulders active, not shrugged to the ears.
Hold for time.

exercises.name: Inverted row
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge.
Body straight, pull the chest to the edge.
Lower slowly.
cues: Check the table is stable first

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: One hand and knee on a bench or chair, back flat.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip.
Lower to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
instructions: Hinge forward, back flat, dumbbells hanging.
Row both to the ribs.
Lower slowly.
cues: Neck in line with the spine

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
instructions: Lie on a bench or the floor holding one dumbbell over the chest.
Lower it in an arc behind the head.
Pull it back over the chest.

exercises.name: Band row
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height or loop it round your feet.
Pull the hands to the ribs.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Hold the band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull it apart to the chest.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Band face pull
instructions: Anchor the band at head height.
Pull towards the forehead, elbows high.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to the upper chest.
Return with control.

exercises.name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge forward, back flat.
Row the bar to the lower ribs.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Farmer's hold
instructions: Stand tall with a heavy dumbbell in each hand.
Shoulders back, grip hard.
Hold or walk for time.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down between your heels, chest up.
Stand tall.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the chest.
Squat between your heels.
Drive up through the whole foot.
cues: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at the chest.
Squat between your heels.
Stand tall.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Step one foot back.
Lower until both knees are about 90°.
Push back to standing; alternate.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunge
instructions: Dumbbells at your sides.
Step back or forward into a lunge.
Drive back up; alternate legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
instructions: Staggered stance, dumbbells at your sides.
Lower the back knee towards the floor.
Stand up; finish one side then switch.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Back foot on a bench or chair.
Lower straight down.
Drive up through the front heel.
cues: Hop the front foot out far enough

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Hinge at the hips, soft knees, back flat.
Stand by squeezing the glutes.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive hips up until in line with the knees.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
instructions: One foot down, other leg straight.
Drive the hips up.
Lower; finish one side then switch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, dumbbell on the hips.
Drive hips up to a straight line.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Step-up
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench.
Step up and stand tall.
Step down slowly; alternate.
cues: Push through the top foot only

exercises.name: Wall sit
instructions: Back flat on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold.

exercises.name: Calf raise
instructions: Stand on a step edge, heels hanging.
Rise onto the toes.
Lower below the step.

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells, stand on a step edge.
Rise onto the toes.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hinge and hike the bell between the legs.
Snap the hips forward to float it to chest height.
Let it fall and hinge again.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back.
Squat to depth with a braced core.
Drive up.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot, grip outside the knees.
Brace and stand up, bar close to the legs.
Lower the same path.

exercises.name: Leg press
instructions: Feet shoulder width on the plate.
Lower until knees are about 90°.
Press without locking the knees.

exercises.name: Bicep curl
instructions: Dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without swinging.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
instructions: Palms facing each other.
Curl up.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Triceps kickback
instructions: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Straighten the elbow fully and squeeze.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower behind the head.
Extend back up.

exercises.name: Band curl
instructions: Stand on the band, handles in hand.
Curl up.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Forearms down, elbows under shoulders.
Body in one straight line, glutes squeezed.
Hold and breathe.

exercises.name: Side plank
instructions: Elbow under the shoulder, legs stacked.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Hold; do both sides.

exercises.name: Dead bug
instructions: On your back, arms up, knees over hips.
Lower opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays down.
Return; alternate.

exercises.name: Bird dog
instructions: On hands and knees.
Reach opposite arm and leg long.
Hold a second; alternate.

exercises.name: Hollow hold
instructions: On your back, lower back pressed down.
Lift shoulders and legs a few inches.
Hold.
cues: Bend the knees to make it easier

exercises.name: Leg raise
instructions: On your back, hands under the hips.
Raise the legs to vertical.
Lower without arching the back.

exercises.name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit leaning back, feet down or raised.
Rotate the torso side to side.
Optionally hold a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Drive knees towards the chest alternately.
Keep hips low.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: On your back, hands by the head.
Bring opposite elbow and knee together.
Alternate slowly.
cues: Do not pull on the neck

exercises.name: Band Pallof press
instructions: Band anchored at chest height to your side.
Press the hands straight out and resist the twist.
Return.

exercises.name: Brisk walk
instructions: Walk at a pace where talking is possible but singing is not.
Swing the arms.
Keep going for the time.

exercises.name: Easy jog
instructions: Warm up with 3 minutes of brisk walking.
Jog at a conversational pace.
Walk breaks are fine early on.

exercises.name: Run–walk intervals
instructions: Alternate running and walking for set times.
Run at an easy pace.
Walk briskly to recover.
cues: Finish feeling you could do more

exercises.name: Tempo run
instructions: Warm up 10 minutes.
Run the distance at a comfortably hard pace.
Cool down with easy jogging.

exercises.name: Sprint intervals
instructions: Warm up 10 minutes with jogging and drills (high knees, A-skips, leg swings).
Run each rep hard.
Walk back to recover fully.

exercises.name: Sprint then jog
instructions: Warm up thoroughly.
Sprint the set distance.
Go straight into a steady jog for the jog distance.
cues: Settle the breathing in the first minute of the jog

exercises.name: Treadmill run
instructions: Start with 3 minutes walking.
Run at the set pace.
Cool down walking.

exercises.name: Stationary cycling
instructions: Set the saddle at hip height.
Pedal at a steady effort.
Add resistance as it gets easy.

exercises.name: Outdoor ride
instructions: Check the bike and wear a helmet.
Ride at a steady effort.
Stay on safe routes.

exercises.name: Skipping rope
instructions: Rope length to the armpits.
Small jumps on the balls of the feet.
Turn from the wrists.

exercises.name: Stair climbing
instructions: Walk up at a steady pace.
Walk down carefully to recover.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Swimming
instructions: Warm up with easy lengths.
Swim the set at a steady effort.
Rest at the wall as needed.

exercises.name: Rowing machine
instructions: Legs, then body, then arms.
Return arms, body, legs.
Steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Jump feet out while raising the arms.
Jump back in.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Burpee
instructions: Squat and put the hands down.
Jump or step back to a plank, then return.
Stand or jump up.
cues: Step back instead of jumping to make it easier

exercises.name: Cat–cow
instructions: On hands and knees.
Round the back up, then let it sag gently.
Move with the breath.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee, other foot forward.
Squeeze the glute and shift forward.
Hold; switch sides.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
instructions: Lie on your back, one leg up.
Hold behind the thigh and straighten gently.
Hold; switch.

exercises.name: Open book rotation
instructions: Lie on your side, knees bent, arms together.
Open the top arm across to the other side.
Return; switch sides.
cues: Follow the hand with your eyes

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: Lunge forward, hand inside the front foot.
Rotate the inside arm to the ceiling.
Return; switch sides.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
instructions: Sit into the deepest squat you can with heels down.
Hold onto something if needed.
Breathe.

exercises.name: Band shoulder pass-through
instructions: Hold a band wide.
Raise it overhead and behind with straight arms.
Bring it back.

exercises.name: Band bow-draw hold
instructions: Hold the band like a bow, front arm straight.
Draw to the corner of the mouth, back elbow high.
Hold, then release slowly. Alternate sides.
cues: Pull with the back, not the hand

exercises.name: Bow draw and hold
instructions: Draw your bow to anchor with good form.
Hold at anchor for the set time.
Let down slowly; never dry-fire.

exercises.name: Archery practice
instructions: Warm up with band draws.
Shoot the set number of arrows with full form.
Rest between ends of 6.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
instructions: Elbow at your side, bent 90°.
Rotate the hand out against the band.
Return slowly.
